newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 26.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 26.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse on Tuesday was at 14.8 million zlotys.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse:
* 4,000 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on February 12, 2001 traded at 84.45 zlotys.
* 1,700 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on October 12, 2001 traded at 81.45 zlotys.
* 10,000 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on October 12, 1998 traded at 94.25 zlotys.
